chapters.title: 识参
chapters.basis: 示例：通用人参知识，用于演示时间轴与排版预检。

pairs.zh: 人参是五加科多年生草本。
pairs.en: Ginseng is a perennial herb in the Araliaceae family.

pairs.zh: 根茎上的芦碗，一年留一个。
pairs.en: Each growing season leaves one crown scar on the rhizome.
The Shennong Bencao Jing lists it among the superior herbs.
Count the scars, and you know its age.

chapters.title: 参须
chapters.basis: 示例：通用人参知识，用于演示时间轴与排版预检。

pairs.zh: 参须是吸收水分的细根。
pairs.en: The rootlets are the fine roots that take up water.
On wild roots they grow long and supple.
The Bencao Gangmu calls them shenxu.
They break most easily while the root is being washed.
